subject.title: feat(durable): hand off wakes to session queue

question: Should a durable wake handed off as a passive `systemEvent` follow the canonical session key across `/reset`, or remain bound to the originating session generation?
rationale: Current main intentionally treats `systemEvent` and `agentTurn` queue entries differently across session-generation changes, and either durable-wake policy is implementable but has different session-state and message-delivery semantics.

options.title: Allow passive carryover
options.body: Keep the current `systemEvent` handoff, explicitly document that reset does not discard durable attention obligations, and add focused cross-reset proof on the canonical PR.

options.title: Fence by generation
options.body: Persist the originating session ID and leave, supersede, or separately surface the wake when the session generation no longer matches.

options.title: Defer the handoff
options.body: Keep the durable stack inspection-only and postpone PR5 until the wake ownership and reset policy is designed separately.

recommendation.title: Allow passive carryover
recommendation.body: Keep the current `systemEvent` handoff, explicitly document that reset does not discard durable attention obligations, and add focused cross-reset proof on the canonical PR.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a repository-level durable-runtime and session-reset product contract, not a narrow implementation defect.
